name: Gold and Dagger
source:
As Prince of Szolnia, Zephyr plays an important role in his kingdom’s yearly celebration. Other than celebrating, he hopes to reunite with his longtime friend, the king, with his guard at his side.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
作为索尔尼亚王子，西风在他王国的年度庆典中扮演着重要的角色。除了庆祝之外，他还希望能与他的老朋友国王重聚，并有他的侍卫在身边。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
